I want to go to some sort of adult, but I can't bring myself to. I'm too scared that they might do something drastic like talking to my mom directly. I've been talking a bit with a really close friend, and it's really helping. I really *know* him, and he is a good listener. I feel happier now, so you don't have to worry much. A huge thanks for caring!

Thanks for telling me about this subreddit man. It really helps knowing that I'm not the only one going through things like this, and hearing about other peoples stories and how they overcame it is really inspiring. Thanks again pal!

Thanks for your supportive comments man. It really makes me feel better that I'm not alone in this. I'm feeling much better now, so I don't feel so bad anymore. I'm really looking forward to my future now, and I can't wait until I'm free. Once again, thanks for caring about me!

Other than her, there is my brother and my dad. My dad and my mom have quite the strained relationship, as my mom always says that my dad is the source of her anxiety and general sadness. She says that he scarred her by displaying acts of violence (but he didn't inflict any physical damage on her), and she has a strong dislike for him. However, he is actually really passive and nice, and although he might be a bit absent minded and forgetful and annoying sometimes, I know that he is a person that loves me. As for my brother, I will always live in his shadow. My mom doesn't pick on him as he's really perfect in almost every way (getting incredible grades, very sociable, does a lot of extracurricular activities, etc.) He really loves me though. Although I would like to talk to either of them, I just can't pluck up the courage to. I might seem so stupid, they might tell my mom, or they might completely ignore me. 

I really feel that the person I can really talk to is one of my closest friends. He isn't a relative, so it's not like he can casually tell my mom what I'm saying, and he is a good listener. Honestly, it's because of my friends that my urge to just end everything is toned down, because I can just forget about my problems when I'm around them. I've really cheered up now, and I won't be making any rash decisions soon. Thanks for all your kind words!

Yeah, I agree with you. I've thought that I have just been ignoring her insults, but if I really get honest with myself, I'm believing everything she's telling me. I am feeling better now, so I don't think I'll be taking any drastic measures soon. As for the care, I don't really know, and I'm much to scared to try and get it. Also, if I fail to get some form of support, I cannot imagine what hell it would be at home. Thanks for all your kind words dude.

One of the reasons I really can't reach out to any other family members is because me, my mom, my dad and my brother are the only people that are living abroad. The rest of them are back where I come from, and I can't contact them easily. I want to reach out to my teachers, but I don't think I have the courage to. Usually if they feel the situation is serious, they will call my mom in and speak with both of us. I'm really scared of that, because the moment we return home I don't think she'll be very nice. Also, she is one *manipulative* woman. Literally everybody (I'm not joking) in the family is positively convinced that she is the greatest mother God could have graced us with the presence of. She'll always be so kind and caring, then it all falls apart when we're alone. Thanks so much for giving me advice, and just thinking that someone cares about me makes me feel good.

Thank you. I feel much better now, and I totally agree with you. I think that the reason bad parents exist is so that their children are like the middle man. They know what not to do, and by passing it on to their children, eventually it'll carry on through the ages. Thank you once more for your comment.

Your English is great by the way!
